Prepare series for a parallel coordinates chart

Source: R/helpers.R
data_to_parallel_coordinates.Rd

Prepare series for a parallel coordinates chart

Usage

data_to_parallel_coordinates(data, ...)

Arguments

data

A data frame of numeric measurements. Each row is an observation and each column is an axis, in display order.

...

Named series options such as name or color. Supply one value for all observations or one value per row.

Value

A tibble for hc_add_series_list() with one series per row. Its data column holds the measurements in their original units. Missing measurements leave gaps on their axes.

Examples

measurements <- iris[1:4]
series <- data_to_parallel_coordinates(measurements, color = colorize(iris$Species))

highchart() |>
  hc_chart(type = "line", parallelCoordinates = TRUE) |>
  hc_xAxis(categories = names(measurements)) |>
  hc_add_series_list(series)
